questions.question_description: Write a C program to implement Breadth First Search (BFS) traversal of a graph. Use an adjacency matrix representation and a queue.
questions.input_format: Integer V (number of vertices), Integer E (number of edges). Next E lines contain 'u v' (and optionally 'w' for weighted) representing an edge.
questions.output_format: Expected standard spacing for algorithms. For traversals, space separated vertices. For MST/Shortest Paths, specific formatting based on the problem.
questions.hints: Leverage standard traversal queues/stacks or algorithms like Prim/Kruskal securely using fixed bounds.
questions.solution_explanation: Graph algorithms dynamically track visited vertices and structural adjacencies internally optimally.
